GPU command intervals include barriers/scheduling: surface_and_shadows (persistent topology classification/transactions/emission/deformation when selected, then shadow depth); rt_as_build; scene_classify_and_raster (opaque geometry and clear background); motion_vectors (opaque-depth diagnostics, empty when disabled); temporal_resolve (history compute, color copy-back and depth snapshot, empty when disabled); scene_overlays (plume, stars, cloud/aurora); display_transform (pre-exposed HDR to SDR, empty when HDR off); ui (after display). Layout v8 separates resolve from overlays; compare scope names and settings, not just totals, with older captures. Scene raster uses RGBA16Float when native_hdr=true. UI extra egui command buffers and queue-write uploads before the first mark are outside GPU intervals. Auto exposure and bloom remain unapplied in this manual HDR slice even when shared settings request them. Unknown world/sim counters retain defaults; no per-frame geometry readback. Up to 1800 measured frames retained
resolved.native_docking_clock: isolated fixed 120 Hz replay; not flight authority or an ephemeris trajectory
resolved.native_jitter_scope: Halton primary terrain/meshes only; motion excludes sampling jitter; resolved only when native_taa=true; secondary view unchanged
